sentences.zh: 每个周末都有成千上万的人走上街头，抗议内塔尼亚胡政府的司法改革计划。

sentences.en: You know, reservists were threatening not to serve.

sentences.en: And there's been this growing conflict between the religious and the secular.
sentences.zh: 宗教与世俗之间的冲突日益加剧。

sentences.en: It seems to me like the country is at war with itself.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这个国家正在与自己开战。

sentences.en: It's as unstable, as unsure as I've ever seen it.
sentences.zh: 它和我见过的任何时候一样不稳定，一样充满不确定性。

sentences.en: What do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: And I worry, I'm worried.
sentences.zh: 我感到忧虑，我很担心。

sentences.en: And I feel that this is part of the existential threat.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也是生存威胁的一部分。

sentences.en: And I feel that one of the reasons Hamas has decided to invade us and kill all those people is
sentences.zh: 我觉得哈马斯决定入侵我们并杀死所有人，原因之一就是

sentences.en: because he looked at the Israeli government and he said to himself, well, this is my moment.
sentences.zh: 他看着以色列政府，心想，好吧，这就是我的时刻。

sentences.en: It's not like Hamas didn't want to kill Jews two years ago, three years ago, four years ago.
sentences.zh: 并不是说哈马斯两年前、三年前、四年前不想杀犹太人。

sentences.en: They always wanted to kill Jews, but they felt that the Israeli government is weakening the state in a way it wasn't weakened before.
sentences.zh: 他们一直想杀犹太人，但他们觉得以色列政府正在以一种前所未有的方式削弱国家。

sentences.en: And therefore, this is their chance.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就是他们的机会。

sentences.en: And they did.
sentences.zh: 他们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: And you're right.
sentences.zh: 你是对的。

sentences.en: I'm as worried as I ever been for the future of our country.
sentences.zh: 我对我们国家的未来感到前所未有的担忧。

sentences.en: It is, it is, I mean, for those of us who are history buffs, we know that sometimes it takes only one really bad government in order to,
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些爱好历史的人来说，我们知道有时候只需要一个真正糟糕的政府，就能把一个国家

sentences.en: I don't want to say destroy, but weaken a country from within significantly.
sentences.zh: 我不想说是毁灭，但会从内部进行显著的削弱。

sentences.en: And we have the wrong government for what we need.
sentences.zh: 我们目前的政府无法满足我们的需求。

sentences.en: And, and we will need to replace it in order to build a better future.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们将不得不取代它，以建立一个更好的未来。

sentences.zh: 拉皮德先生，非常感谢。

sentences.zh: 这其实并不是我们对话的完全结束，因为我几天后还要和你谈谈。

sentences.zh: 我很高兴能向拉皮德先生提出我心头挥之不去的一些问题。

sentences.en: And he told me more about why he feels misunderstood.

sentences.en: Hi, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 嗨，露露。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: This is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 这里是《访谈》栏目。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia-Devaro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: Mr. Lapid.
sentences.zh: 拉皮德先生。

sentences.en: The reason I wanted to talk to you is because I wanted to understand, you know, what the current Israeli opposition stands for.
sentences.zh: 我想跟你谈谈的原因是，我想了解目前的以色列反对派究竟代表了什么。

sentences.en: However, the opposition that I knew when I was there around 2012, that no longer exists.
sentences.zh: 然而，我2012年在那儿时所了解的那个反对派，已经不复存在了。

sentences.en: As you know, the left is gone now.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，左翼现在已经消失了。

sentences.en: And so I wanted to sort of understand what kind of opposition you represent.
sentences.zh: 所以我想大致了解一下，你代表的是什么样的一种反对派。

sentences.en: As we've been talking, what I've heard is as it comes to the war, there's really not a lot of opposition at all.
sentences.zh: 正如我们一直以来的交谈，我听到的是，在对待这场战争的态度上，几乎根本没有什么反对的声音。

sentences.en: And Israel is being accused of genocide, of war crimes.
sentences.zh: 以色列正被指控犯有种族灭绝罪和战争罪。

sentences.en: And as we've talked, you've defended the conduct of the war, and you've referred to yourself as an Israeli patriot.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所谈到的，你为战争的进行进行了辩护，并且自称为以色列爱国者。

sentences.en: But I suppose my question is, can patriotism not also be defined as questioning the conduct of this war?
sentences.zh: 但我想我的问题是，爱国主义难道不可以被定义为对这场战争的进行提出质疑吗？

sentences.en: Of course it is.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I assume I was reacting, it is not to you, but to what I feel is the betrayal of the intellectuals.
sentences.zh: 我想我的反应——这并非针对你，而是针对我所感受到的知识分子的背叛。

sentences.en: Meaning that people, the intellectuals of the West, or some of them, has betrayed the idea of complexity, of,
sentences.zh: 也就是说，西方知识分子，或者其中一部分人，背叛了复杂性的理念，关于……

sentences.en: is this either genocide or existential war for Israel, or are there other options?
sentences.zh: 这究竟是对以色列的种族灭绝还是生死存亡之战，抑或是还有其他选择？

sentences.en: Because what I think is that, and this is my duty as the leader of the Israeli opposition, is to tell the Israeli government, you need to handle this war better than you do now.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为，作为以色列反对派领袖，我的职责就是告诉以色列政府，你们需要比现在更好地处理这场战争。

sentences.en: We understand the need, of course, to defend the country, to defend the people, to react to what happened on October 7th, and to eliminate all Hamas' military capabilities.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们理解防卫国家、防卫人民、对10月7日发生的事件作出反应以及消灭哈马斯所有军事能力的必要性。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, to stay what we are, which is a democracy that feels about human rights, that is doing its best in terms of defending the idea of humanity.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我们要保持我们的本色，即一个珍视人权、在捍卫人道主义理念方面竭尽所能的民主国家。

sentences.en: And as we have discussed, defend this in circumstances that are no less than horrible.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所讨论的，在极其糟糕的环境下捍卫这一点。

sentences.en: And the dialogue I have, or we have, with the outside world, is either with people who are chanting slogans they don't really understand,
sentences.zh: 我或我们与外界的对话，要么是和那些高喊他们并不真正理解的口号的人进行，

sentences.en: or who are determined to make this into a one-sided story.
sentences.zh: 要么是和那些决心把这一切变成一面倒的故事的人进行。

sentences.en: No, Israel is not committing genocide.
sentences.zh: 不，以色列没有实施种族灭绝。

sentences.en: No, Israel is not doing anything but defend itself in a war we didn't want.
sentences.zh: 不，以色列在一场我们不想要的战争中除了自卫没有做任何别的事。

sentences.en: And these are not pro-government sayings.
sentences.zh: 这些并非亲政府的言论。

sentences.en: This is just the reality of people who are hurting.
sentences.zh: 这只是那些遭受痛苦的人民的现实。

sentences.en: And the fact that I oppose the government so much doesn't mean I need to oppose the idea of self-defense.
sentences.zh: 我强烈反对政府，并不意味着我需要反对自卫的理念。

sentences.en: Yeah, I understand that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我理解这一点。

sentences.en: And I feel what I'm thinking about, actually, is just what it means in a moment like this
sentences.zh: 我其实在想的是，在这样一个时刻，

sentences.en: to effectively, even if you care about Israel and the Israelis, say, this is not okay.
sentences.zh: 即使你关心以色列和以色列人，却去有效地宣称“这不对劲”，究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: You know, earlier you disparaged the young people in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你早些时候贬低了美国那些

sentences.en: marching for Palestinian rights.
sentences.zh: 为巴勒斯坦人权利游行的年轻人。

sentences.en: And you say that they're clueless and misled.
sentences.zh: 你说他们一无所知、受到误导。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't think they're marching for your Palestinian rights.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不认为他们是在为巴勒斯坦人的权利游行。

sentences.en: I think they're marching against Palestinian rights.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们是在反对巴勒斯坦人的权利。

sentences.en: I think what they're doing is against the best interests of the Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们的所作所为违背了巴勒斯坦人民的最佳利益。

sentences.en: Yeah, but doesn't that dismiss their sort of legitimate concerns and that people may have generally about the civilian deaths?
sentences.zh: 是的，但难道这没有对他们以及人们对平民伤亡可能普遍存在的合理关切不予理睬吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think they should understand that there is a reason
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他们应该明白，这一切的发生

sentences.en: why everything is happening is happening.
sentences.zh: 都有其原因。

sentences.en: And the reason is Hamas.
sentences.zh: 原因就是哈马斯。

sentences.en: The reason is not Israel.
sentences.zh: 原因不是以色列。

sentences.en: I mean, not to be able to even track why what is happening is happening is a total lack of even, I don't know, intellectual dignity or at least curiosity to what is going on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，甚至无法追踪发生这一切的原因，这完全缺乏哪怕是——我不知道——知识分子的尊严，或者至少是对正在发生的事情的好奇心。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was thinking after our first discussion, I was trying to figure out because I told myself, well, at one point or another, I was defensive and she was defensive.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在我们第一次讨论之后，我一直在思考、试图弄清楚，因为我对自己说，好吧，在某个时刻我处于防御状态，而她也处于防御状态。

sentences.en: Why was it?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: So I don't know about you, but I know about myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道你怎么样，但我很了解我自己。

sentences.en: And the reason is because I refuse to be involved in a context in which who is the victim.
sentences.zh: 原因是我拒绝卷入一种关于“谁是受害者”的语境中。

sentences.en: I am done being a victim.
sentences.zh: 我当够受害者了。

sentences.en: I am done being a victim since June 1945.
sentences.zh: 自1945年6月以来，我当够受害者了。

sentences.en: So the thing is that now in order to get the sympathy and the empathy of the Western world, I have to say to remind them every five seconds
sentences.zh: 所以问题在于，现在为了获得西方世界的同情和共情，我不得不每隔五秒钟就提醒他们一次

sentences.en: that we are the victims in this is to me is a horrible idea.
sentences.zh: 我们是其中的受害者，在我看来这是一个糟糕透顶的想法。

sentences.en: I rather tell them, listen, we're fighting for their life and we're going to do whatever is necessary in order to win this fight because we are done being victiMs.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿告诉他们，听着，我们在为自己的生存而战，我们将采取一切必要手段赢得这场战斗，因为我们当够受害者了。

sentences.en: Now, the more popular thing to do is to go into a fistfight with the Palestinians about the question, who is hurting more?
sentences.zh: 现在，更受欢迎的做法是与巴勒斯坦人就“谁受到的伤害更大”这个问题进行一场口水战。

sentences.en: But this is a pleasure I'm not going to give anyone.
sentences.zh: 但这是我绝不会给任何人的乐趣。

sentences.en: So maybe this is why I became a bit frustrated in our previous conversation because I was supposed to prove that I am more of a victim than the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这就是为什么我在我们之前的对话中变得有点沮丧，因为我本该去证明我比巴勒斯坦人更像受害者。

sentences.en: I am no victim.
sentences.zh: 我不是受害者。

sentences.en: I am a citizen, a proud citizen of a great country who is fighting for its life in terrible circumstances while trying our best not to hurt the Palestinians
sentences.zh: 我是一个公民，是一个伟大国家的骄傲公民，在可怕的环境中为生存而战，同时尽我们最大努力不去伤害巴勒斯坦人，

sentences.en: because they are living here with us and we need to find ways to make sure they have a future as well.
sentences.zh: 因为他们和我们生活在一起，我们需要找到方法确保他们也拥有未来。

sentences.en: It's always struck me as a fundamental disconnect because Israel doesn't feel there is enough acknowledgement of the existential threat that they're under.
sentences.zh: 这总是让我觉得有一种根本性的脱节，因为以色列觉得人们对他们所承受的生存威胁没有给予足够的承认。

sentences.en: You're articulating this right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在正在阐述这一点。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Israel's critics on the Palestinian question want Israel to see that it can't be a true democracy with real security when it oppresses and occupies millions of Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 而以色列在巴勒斯坦问题上的批评者希望以色列明白，当它压迫和占领数百万巴勒斯坦人时，它不可能成为一个拥有真正安全的正宗民主国家。

sentences.en: So I'm wondering, can you understand that point of view?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，你能理解那种观点吗？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And since you have covered Israel, then you know, unlike others, the numerous time now that Israel has offered the Palestinians statehood
sentences.zh: 既然你报道过以色列，那你就会知道，与其他人不同，以色列已经无数次向巴勒斯坦人提供建国地位，

sentences.en: and they refused again and again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 而他们一次又一次、一次又一次地拒绝了。

sentences.en: But, you know, there's another version of this story.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这个故事还有另一个版本。

sentences.en: So I guess...
sentences.zh: 所以我想……

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, there is another version of this story, but it's not the right one.
sentences.zh: 是的，这个故事确实有另一个版本，但它不是正确的版本。

sentences.en: And I was involved, so I know.
sentences.zh: 我曾身处其中，所以我知道。

sentences.en: And I want to tell you something else.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你另一件事。

sentences.en: I walked one day to a meeting with a very smart foreign minister.
sentences.zh: 有一天我去和一个非常聪明的外交部长会面。

sentences.en: It was years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是几年前的事了。

sentences.en: She was one of the smartest people I know.
sentences.zh: 她是我认识最聪明的人之一。

sentences.en: And she came into the room and she started the conversation by telling me that, like everybody does, people always say that.
sentences.zh: 她走进房间，一开始就告诉我——就像所有人一样，人们总是这么说——

sentences.en: She said, you know, we recognize Israel's right to defend itself.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，我们承认以色列自卫的权利。

sentences.en: And I said, why are you saying this?
sentences.zh: 我说，你为什么这么说？

sentences.en: And she said, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 她说，你是什么意思？

sentences.en: I said, do you go into a meeting with the French foreign minister and tell him that you recognize France's right to defend itself?
sentences.zh: 我说，你跟法国外长会面时，会告诉他你承认法国自卫的权利吗？

sentences.en: Is there any other country you tell that they have a right to defend itself?
sentences.zh: 还有哪个国家你会特意告诉他们有自卫的权利？

sentences.en: Why are you emphasizing the fact...
sentences.zh: 你为什么要在强调这个事实……

sentences.en: I wasn't angry with her.
sentences.zh: 我并没有生她的气。

sentences.en: I was just curious about the question.
sentences.zh: 我只是对这个问题感到好奇。

sentences.en: Why is it that she felt the need to tell me that I'm entitled to defend myself and not to die silently?
sentences.zh: 为什么她觉得有必要告诉我，我有权进行自卫而不是默默死去？

sentences.en: And now, I think you and I have succeeded, which is a great success, to go that far into our conversation without mentioning the possibility that maybe it is because we are Jews.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想你和我已经成功了——这是一个巨大的成功——在对话中深入到这个地步，却没有提及这或许是因为我们是犹太人这种可能性。

sentences.en: But maybe it is because we are Jews.
sentences.zh: 但也许这确实是因为我们是犹太人。

sentences.en: This is something I've heard a lot from Jews outside of Israel and obviously inside Israel.
sentences.zh: 这是我从以色列国外的犹太人那里，以及显然从以色列国内听过很多次的话。

sentences.en: But you also know the other side of this, which is that many Palestinians look at the context of the occupation,
sentences.zh: 但你也知道这件事的另一面，那就是许多巴勒斯坦人审视占领的语境，

sentences.en: look at how they have been treated, and say that this context isn't as simple as who is the victim of this particular cycle of violence.
sentences.zh: 审视他们是如何被对待的，并认为这种语境并不像“谁是这轮特定暴力冲突的受害者”那么简单。

sentences.en: Well, I don't want this cycle of violence.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也不希望有这轮暴力冲突。

sentences.en: And no Israeli in his right mind.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个神智正常的以色列人会希望这样。

sentences.en: We have our own fair share of lunatics.
sentences.zh: 我们自己也有相当多的疯子。

sentences.en: I am not going to defend them.
sentences.zh: 我不会为他们辩护。

sentences.en: But the majority of Israelis doesn't want this cycle of violence.
sentences.zh: 但大多数以色列人不希望有这轮暴力冲突。

sentences.en: And if somebody will enable from the Palestinians,
sentences.zh: 如果巴勒斯坦方面有人能够促成这一点，

sentences.en: meaning if we will have somebody to talk to on the Palestinian side about separating, there will be a vast majority of Israelis for this separation.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果我们能在巴勒斯坦方面找到人来谈论隔离，以色列将有绝大多数人支持这种隔离。

sentences.en: And the problem is right now, listen, you are hearing it's not against you.
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是，听着，你听到这些并不是针对你。

sentences.en: What you're hearing is frustration.
sentences.zh: 你听到的是挫败感。

sentences.en: Because I do not seem to put my mind around the fact that five minutes after the worst massacre of Jews since the Holocaust,
sentences.zh: 因为我似乎无法理解这样一个事实：在犹太人大屠杀之后针对犹太人的最惨烈大屠杀发生五分钟后，

sentences.en: we are already defending ourselves from people who are telling us, well, we question your right to defend yourself because this is, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 我们已经在为自己辩护，去面对那些对我们说“嗯，我们质疑你自卫的权利，因为这——我不知道——

sentences.en: it's again, you are part of the white privileged world, and therefore you are not entitled to self-defense.
sentences.zh: 这又是，你是白人特权世界的一部分，因此你无权进行自卫”。

sentences.en: It doesn't make sense to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说毫无道理。

sentences.en: It frustrates me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And I hate the idea that I keep telling myself that I'm glad that my father is not alive.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌这种想法，我一直在对自己说，我庆幸我的父亲已经不在人世了，

sentences.en: To see this.
sentences.zh: 不用看到这一切。

sentences.en: Your father, Tommy Lapid, who was, of course, a minister,
sentences.zh: 你的父亲汤米·拉皮德，他当然曾是一名部长，

sentences.en: and a Holocaust survivor.
sentences.zh: 也是大屠杀幸存者。

sentences.en: And a Holocaust survivor.
sentences.zh: 也是大屠杀幸存者。

sentences.en: I remember him well.
sentences.zh: 我对他印象深刻。

sentences.en: His entire life was the basement in the Budapest ghetto in which the Nazis put him in.
sentences.zh: 他的一生都围绕着布达佩斯犹太人区的地下室，纳粹曾把他关在那里。

sentences.en: And then if he was alive now, he would be locked with me and my daughter with special needs in the basement of my house because somebody is trying to kill us again.
sentences.zh: 如果他现在还活着，他就会和我以及我那有特殊需求的女儿一起被锁在我家的地下室里，因为又有人试图杀死我们。

sentences.en: So this, the fact that we do not seem to be able to rescue ourselves from being locked in a basement surrounded by people who want to kill us
sentences.zh: 所以这一点——我们似乎无法将自己从被锁在地下室里、四周都是想杀死我们的人的困境中解救出来——

sentences.en: is pretty frustrating for the people of Israel.
sentences.zh: 对以色列人民来说是非常令人沮丧的。

sentences.en: This is my last question, but this is a question about the future because, you know, a poll by the Israel Democracy Institute shows that 63%
sentences.zh: 这是我的最后一个问题，但这是一个关于未来的问题，因为，你知道的，以色列民主研究所的一项民意调查显示，63%

sentences.en: of the Jewish Israeli public now do not support an independent Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 的以色列犹太公众现在不支持一个独立的巴勒斯坦国。

sentences.en: You say that is because of the history, and that very well may be true.
sentences.zh: 你说这是因为历史原因，这很可能是真的。

sentences.en: And you've made it very clear where you stand.
sentences.zh: 你也已经非常明确地表达了你的立场。

sentences.en: You want to see the Netanyahu government resign.
sentences.zh: 你希望看到内塔尼亚胡政府辞职。

sentences.en: You do believe in a two-state solution.
sentences.zh: 你确实相信两国方案。

sentences.en: But it seems that even if Bibi goes, his politics remain popular.
sentences.zh: 但似乎即便比比下台，他的政治路线依然很受欢迎。

sentences.en: So where does that leave, I guess, the opposition after this war, the very prospect of peace?
sentences.zh: 那么，这让反对派在战后处于什么位置，和平的前景又在何方？

sentences.en: How do you move Israelis to your side?
sentences.zh: 你如何把以色列人争取到你这一边？

sentences.en: Well, idea.
sentences.zh: 嗯，理念。

sentences.en: I mean, politics can be, as you very well know, horrible, but also sometimes very rarely also beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你非常清楚的那样，政治可以很残酷，但有时在极少数情况下也很美好。

sentences.en: And it is only beautiful is when you get a chance to change people's minds, to talk to them, to be able to communicate to them new ideas.
sentences.zh: 只有当你获得机会去改变人们的想法、与他们交谈、向他们传达新理念时，它才是美好的。

sentences.en: And it's always a battle for ideas.
sentences.zh: 这永远是一场关于理念的争斗。

sentences.en: And it's the only battle worth living for.
sentences.zh: 这也是唯一值得为之奋斗的战斗。

sentences.en: I am, as I said, and you quoted, I'm a patriot.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，也正如你所引用的，我是一名爱国者。

sentences.en: And you're right, patriotism is sometimes telling people what they don't want to hear.
sentences.zh: 你说得对，爱国主义有时就是把人们不想听的话告诉他们。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: You always have this question about what leadership is.
sentences.zh: 你总是会问关于什么是领导力的问题。

sentences.en: And what people tend to forget is that leadership is always opposite your own people, not the enemy.
sentences.zh: 人们往往忘记的是，领导力总是针对你自己的民众，而不是敌人。

sentences.en: Opposite the enemy, get two good generals, and they will fight the war for you.
sentences.zh: 面对敌人，找两个优秀的将军，他们会为你打这场仗。

sentences.en: And besides, there's simplicity into it, because it's a war, and they are against you, then you have to fight back.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，这其中还有一种简单性，因为这是一场战争，他们与你为敌，那你必须反击。

sentences.en: When you go to your own people and tell them things they don't want to hear and convince them in one way or another, this is what we're going to try and do.
sentences.zh: 当你走向自己的民众，告诉他们不想听的话，并以某种方式说服他们时，这才是我们要尝试去做的事情。

sentences.en: We're going to try and make the Netanyahu government go away because it's disastrous and dangerous and irresponsible and non-functional on top of this.
sentences.zh: 我们将努力让内塔尼亚胡政府下台，因为它不仅灾难深重、危险、不负责任，而且最重要的是无法正常运转。

sentences.en: And then we're going to tell the Israelis we have to make a decision about our future.
sentences.zh: 然后我们要告诉以色列人，我们必须对我们的未来做出决定。

sentences.en: And this decision is going to be based on the idea that I discussed with you, that in order to stay the strongest country in the Middle East,
sentences.zh: 这个决定将基于我跟你探讨过的理念：为了保持中东最强大的国家，

sentences.en: we also need to stay the strongest democracy in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们也必须保持中东最强大的民主国家。

sentences.en: And in order to be that democracy, we have to start the long journey, the 1,000 mile, the first step of the 1,000 mile journey to separate from the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 为了成为那样的民主国家，我们必须开启漫长的征程，万里长征的第一步，即与巴勒斯坦人分离。

sentences.zh: 拉皮德先生，非常感谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
